title: BotEstopClearedPayload
description: bot.estop.cleared v1 (OpenVibe.Bot server/domain/index.js writeEstop via clearEstop). The owner cleared the latched e-stop (only the owner can); principal_kind is user, and Bot sends by as null. Envelope: subject { type: robot, id: <robot id> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:bot.
